segments.text: Lesson 39
segments.translation: 第39课

segments.text: What every writer wants
segments.translation: 每个作家都想要什么

segments.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
segments.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。

segments.text: How do professional writers ignore what they were taught at school about writing?
segments.translation: 职业作家如何忽视学校所教授的写作知识？

segments.text: I have known very few writers,
segments.translation: 我认识的作家很少，

segments.text: but those I have known and whom I respect, confess at once that they have little idea where they are going when they first set pen to paper.
segments.translation: 但那些我认识的、我尊敬的人立刻承认，当他们第一次动笔写字时，他们根本不知道自己要去哪里。

segments.text: They have a character, perhaps two;
segments.translation: 他们有一个性格，也许有两个；

segments.text: they are in that condition of eager discomfort which passes for inspiration all admit radical changes of destination once the journey has begun;
segments.translation: 他们处于一种急切的不适状态，这种状态被视为灵感，一旦旅程开始，他们都会承认目的地发生根本性的变化。

segments.text: one, to my certain knowledge, spent nine months on a novel about Kashmir,
segments.translation: 据我所知，其中一个花了九个月的时间写了一本关于克什米尔的小说，

segments.text: then reset the whole thing in the Scottish Highlands.
segments.translation: 然后在苏格兰高地重置整个事情。

segments.text: I never heard of anyone making a 'skeleton', as we were taught at school.
segments.translation: 我从来没有听说过有人制作“骷髅”，正如我们在学校所学到的那样。

segments.text: In the breaking and remaking, in the timing interweaving, beginning afresh,
segments.translation: 在打破与重塑中，在时间的交织中，重新开始，

segments.text: the writer comes to discern things in his material which were not consciously in his mind when he began.
segments.translation: 作者开始在他的材料中辨别出一些在他开始时并没有意识到的东西。

segments.text: This organic process, often leading to moments of extraordinary self-discovery, is of an indescribable fascination.
segments.translation: 这种有机的过程往往会带来非凡的自我发现时刻，具有难以形容的魅力。

segments.text: A blurred image appears; he adds a brushstroke and another and it is gone
segments.translation: 出现模糊的图像；

segments.text: but something was there, and he will not rest till he has captured it.
segments.translation: 但那里有东西，他不抓住它就不会休息。

segments.text: Sometimes the yeast within a writer outlives a book he has written.
segments.translation: 有时，作家内心的酵母比他写的书还要长久。

segments.text: I have heard of writers who read nothing but their own books;
segments.translation: 我听说过有些作家只读自己的书。

segments.text: like adolescents they stand before the mirror,
segments.translation: 他们像青少年一样站在镜子前，

segments.text: and still cannot fathom the exact outline of the vision before them.
segments.translation: 仍然无法理解眼前幻象的确切轮廓。

segments.text: For the same reason, writers talk interminably about their own books,
segments.translation: 出于同样的原因，作家们没完没了地谈论自己的书，

segments.text: winkling out hidden meanings, super-imposing new ones,
segments.translation: 揭示隐藏的含义，叠加新的含义，

segments.text: begging response from those around them.
segments.translation: 请求周围人的回应。

segments.text: Of course a writer doing this is misunderstood: he might as well try to explain a crime or a love affair.
segments.translation: 当然，这样做的作家会被误解：他还不如尝试解释犯罪或爱情。

segments.text: He is also, incidentally, an unforgivable bore.
segments.translation: 顺便说一句，他也是一个不可原谅的讨厌鬼。

segments.text: This temptation to cover the distance between himself and the reader,
segments.translation: 这种拉近自己与读者之间距离的诱惑，

segments.text: to study his image in the sight of those who do not know him, can be his undoing: he has begun to write to please.
segments.translation: 研究他在那些不认识他的人眼中的形象，可能会导致他的毁灭：他已经开始为了取悦而写作。

segments.text: A young English writer made the pertinent observation a year or two back
segments.translation: 一位年轻的英国作家在一两年前做出了相关的观察

segments.text: that the talent goes into the first draft, and the art into the drafts that follow.
segments.translation: 人才进入初稿，艺术进入后续草稿。

segments.text: For this reason also the writer, like any other artist,
segments.translation: 出于这个原因，作家也像其他艺术家一样，

segments.text: has no resting place, no crowd or movement in which he may take comfort,
segments.translation: 没有休息的地方，没有人群或运动可以让他感到安慰，

segments.text: no judgment from outside which can replace the judgment from within.
segments.translation: 任何外部的判断都不能取代内部的判断。

segments.text: A writer makes order out of the anarchy of his heart;
segments.translation: 作家将内心的混乱整理得井井有条；

segments.text: he submits himself to a more ruthless discipline than any critic dreamed of,
segments.translation: 他让自己受到比任何批评家所梦想的更残酷的纪律，

segments.text: and when he flirts with fame, he is taking time off from living with himself,
segments.translation: 当他与名声调情时，他就从与自己相处的时间中抽出时间，

segments.text: from the search for what his world contains at its inmost point.
segments.translation: 来自对他的世界最深处的探索。
